Get help

Resolve common connection, review, and delivery problems.

Get help

  • GitHub unavailable: renew CLI sign-in or update the token in Settings → Integrations → GitHub. Check repository access.
  • Agent unavailable: sign in under Settings → Agents → Models, then Check. Inspect repository overrides too.
  • Review could not finish: use Resume review, or Recover runtime first when shown. Wait for a provider limit to reset or select another available provider.
  • Queue paused: address the displayed cause, then Resume queue.
  • Comment delivery unconfirmed: check GitHub. For a missing comment, choose Submit review → Confirmed not posted before submitting again. If it posted, choose Confirmed posted so it is never sent again.
  • Review text unconfirmed: the text and verdict stay as sent and Submit review is off. Choose Confirmed posted to clear it, or Confirmed not posted to submit it again.
  • Post now unconfirmed: the comment waits in Submit review as Delivery unconfirmed. Posting it again is refused until you confirm it there.
  • Check failed: expand it in PR → Show log, or use Open in GitHub. Rerun failed tests appears when supported and permitted.

For building from source, read CONTRIBUTING. For product intent, read the design and architecture.
